QuestInfo.name: [Freud's Journal] Finding The Ring
QuestInfo.0: The old warrior is being threatened by monsters. Go help him.
QuestInfo.1: You risked your life to rescue the old warrior. At the last moment, his ring shimmered and teleported both of you to a safe area. The warrior wants you to pick up that ring.
QuestInfo.2: When you picked up the ring, you saw the memories of the ring's creator. It was none other than Freud the Dragon Master.\r\nThe old warrior said the ring found its new owner and wants to grow to its fullest potential.\r\n
